speaker.name: Reliability Ruth
speaker.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

output.objection: You framed my suggestion as a failure to automate, but I am simply asking you to respect the operational cost of the manual check. Do not present my caution as a gap in our delivery pipeline.
output.correction: I did not say the drift check is impossible to automate, I said the current latency makes automation risky for the morning order window. Read my proposal as a conditional constraint, not a permanent state.
